name: Counting Your Blessings
overview: Scripture calls believers to recognize and continually praise the Lord for His abundant blessings and steadfast mercy. The Psalms encourage us to bless the LORD with all our soul, remembering His benefits and goodness that endure forever. God's promise to bless and keep His people, as seen in Numbers 6:24, assures us of His faithful care, inviting us to count our blessings by acknowledging His favor and provision in every circumstance.
